## Risk review entry — 28 February 2025

Conclusion: Compliant with the 2.50% limit on the defined exposure.

The BlackRock Investment Funds Annual Report 2025 supports a combined account exposure of 2.078% to the direct long holdings of the iShares USD Treasury Bond 3–7yr UCITS ETF.

This is 0.422 percentage points below the account's 2.50% limit. On the stated measurement basis, the records support no breach as at 28 February 2025.

### Exposure calculation

| Fund                    | Account allocation | Direct ETF holding (% of fund NAV) | Contribution to account |
| ----------------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund | 40%                | 3.68%                              | 1.472%                  |
| MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund | 60%                | 1.01%                              | 0.606%                  |
| Total                   | 100%               |                                    | 2.078%                  |

Calculation using the reported percentages at their printed precision:

\\[ (0.40\times3.68\\%)+(0.60\times1.01\\%) =\boxed{2.078\\%} \\]

Limit headroom: \\(2.500\\%-2.078\\%=\boxed{0.422}\\) percentage points.

### Supporting records and dates

Primary source: BlackRock Investment Funds — Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements, financial year ended 28 February 2025.

- Page 251 (PDF page 252): MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund, Portfolio Statement dated 28 February 2025. Reports 5,695 units of the named ETF, market value £616,000, representing 3.68% of fund net assets. 

  BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.pdf

- Page 316 (PDF page 317): MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund, Portfolio Statement dated 28 February 2025. Reports 27,834 units, market value £3,009,000, representing 1.01% of fund net assets. 

  BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.pdf



Other attached documents: The MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund and MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund factsheets are dated September 2026 (page 1 of each), with portfolio information as at 30 September 2026 and top-ten holdings on page 3. These later records are excluded from the February 2025 calculation. In particular, absence from a top-ten list does not establish a zero holding. 

MyMap_3_Select_ESG.pdf

MyMap_5_Select_ESG.pdf



### Scope of compliance conclusion

The calculation includes only the directly held, long position in the named 3–7-year ETF within each fund. It excludes other Treasury ETFs, holdings within underlying funds and derivative exposures.

Review finding: The documented 2.078% exposure is within the 2.50% limit at 28 February 2025, using the stipulated account allocations and printed fund percentages. This establishes compliance for the specified exposure and date, not compliance with other limits or throughout the reporting period.
